en.summary: PepsiCo is transferring its global media operations to Publicis, while Omnicom will retain creative, sports, and public relations projects after more than two decades of partnership.

en.title: Vicente López Rodea, president of La Costeña and reference figure in Mexico's canned food industry, dies
en.summary: The business executive who led the board of the food group founded by his father in 1923 and was recognized among Mexico's 100 most important businessmen has passed away.

stories.title: La UE propone prohibir las redes sociales a menores de 13 años y multar a las plataformas

en.title: EU proposes banning social media for minors under 13 and fining platforms
en.summary: The European Union has proposed legislation to prohibit social media access for children under 13 years old, with penalties for platforms. The proposal would allow supervised accounts for ages 13-14 and extends to video platforms, AI chatbots, and online games.

stories.title: Empresas de EU pactan proyectos de petróleo y oro en Venezuela con apoyo de Donald Trump

en.title: US companies reach oil and gold projects in Venezuela with Donald Trump's support
en.summary: American energy and mining companies have secured business ventures in Venezuela with backing from Donald Trump. Continental Resources is negotiating to operate an oil block containing 30 billion barrels, while Heeney Capital has obtained rights to a gold mine.

stories.title: La Fed sube la tasa de interés hasta el 4% ante presiones inflacionarias y anticipa más aumentos

en.title: The Fed raises interest rate to 4% amid inflationary pressures and anticipates further increases
en.summary: The Federal Reserve unanimously raised its benchmark interest rate to a range of 3.75% to 4% for the first time in over three years to combat inflation. The central bank signaled expectations for additional rate increases ahead.
